mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3% over three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when this trigger is met, or the trigger fires but the median return is not statistically different from zero at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 3% coincident with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -3% AND HOUST < previous year's average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the trigger fires but the average return is not significantly below zero at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate above 8% for four consecutive months signals persistent labor market slack, which reduces wage growth and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% for three consecutive months signals contraction in the manufacturing sector, which reduces earnings visibility and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -1.0% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the trigger does not precede a statistically significant decline in returns at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp reduction in the federal funds rate below 1% during a recession signals an aggressive monetary easing, which lowers risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations through lower discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically greater than zero at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) of more than 2% for five consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces revenue growth expectations for S&P 500 constituents and leads to negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS monthly change < -2.0% for five consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both the unemployment rate and payroll employment (PAYEMS) month-over-month, where unemployment increases while payroll employment also increases, signals a compositional shift toward lower-wage jobs and reduced labor quality, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases AND PAYEMS increases in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered months, or the average return is not statistically below zero at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) of more than 5% for four consecutive months signals a robust recovery in residential construction demand, which boosts materials and homebuilding sector earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly change > 5.0% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically greater than zero at the 5% level.
